in_marathi.name: Naagesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Serpents
in_marathi.long_meaning: Naagesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Naagesh is a name derived from the Sanskrit language, meaning 'Lord of Serpents'. In Hindu mythology, Naagesh is the king of all serpents, and is often depicted as a powerful and benevolent deity. He is believed to protect devotees from harm and bestow blessings.
